fighters.name: Mirefolk Outcast with Bilewood Weapon and Shield
Bloated one with Raker-claw and Hooked Net

abilities.name: Blowpipe
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 6" of this fighter and roll 2 dice.  For each 4+, allocate a number of damage points to that fighter equal to half the value of this ability (rounding up).  In addition, for each 6, subtract 1 from that fighter's Toughness characteristic until the end of the battle round.

abilities.name: Gruesome Harvest
abilities.text: A fighter can use this ability only if an enemy fighter has been taken down by a melee attack action made by them this activation.  This fighter now has a *potent vial* until the end of the battle.  While a fighter has a potent vial, when they use an ability, the value of the ability is treated as being 6 even if the ability dice show a different score.

abilities.name: Hooked Net
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a dice.  On a 3+, allocate a number of damage points to that figther equal to the roll, and that fighter cannot make move actions or disengage actions for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Lethal Injection
abilities.text: Pick a visible enemy fighter within 1" of this fighter and roll a number of dice equal to the value of this ability.  For each roll that exceeds the Toughness characteristic of that fighter, allocate 5 damage points to them.

abilities.name: Slashing Attack
abilities.text: Roll a dice for each visible enemy fighter within 3" of this fighter.  On a 3-4, allocate 1 damage point to the fighter being rolled for.  On a 5-6, allocate a number of damage points to the fighter being rolled for equal to the value of this ability.

abilities.name: Ensnaring Strike
abilities.text: This fighter makes a bonus attack action.  In addition, if that attack action scores any critical hits, the target fighter cannot make move actions or disengage actions for the rest of the battle round.

abilities.name: Bile Blood
abilities.text: A fighter can make this reaction when they are targeted by a melee attack action.  After the damage is totalled but before it is allocated to this fighter, roll a dice for each critical hit scored from that attack action.  For each 3+, allocate 3 damage points to the fighter that made that attack action.

abilities.name: Waiting for the Lord Leech
abilities.text: Enemy fighters that are within 1" of two or more friendly fighters with this battle trait cannot make disengage actions.
